# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 71 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 71

**1** Jesus said: "I will bring this house down, and no one will ever be able to raise it up again."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Bring this house down" — idiomatic and vivid
- "Raise it up again" — the resurrection/rebuilding verb used in the temple sayings; here denied
- "Ever" adds emphatic finality absent in the Coptic but consistent with the tone
